cues.en: Hello everyone and welcome to the principal component analysis lecture if you want a more mathematical background and a deeper dive into principle component analysis.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到主成分分析教學。想深入數學背景，

cues.en: Go ahead and read Section ten point two of an introduction to statistical learning.
cues.zh: 可讀《Introduction to Statistical Learning》第 10.2 節。

cues.en: Now let's discuss the basic idea behind principle component analysis or PCA.
cues.zh: 現在討論主成分分析，PCA 的基本概念。

cues.en: PCa is an unsupervised artistical technique used to examine the interrelations among a set of variables in order to identify the underlying structure of those variables.
cues.zh: PCA 是非監督式統計技術，檢視變數間關係，辨識底層結構。

cues.en: It is also known sometimes as a general factor analysis where regression determines a line of best fit to a data set.
cues.zh: 有時也叫一般因子分析。迴歸為資料找最佳擬合線，

cues.en: Factor Analysis determines several orthogonal lines of best fit to the data set orthogonal just means at right angles.
cues.zh: 因子分析找數條互相正交的最佳線。正交就是直角。

cues.en: Actually those lines are perpendicular to each other.
cues.zh: 也就是彼此垂直，

cues.en: In the end dimensional space where the end dimensional space is the variable sample space.
cues.zh: 位在 n 維空間，這個空間是變數樣本空間。

cues.en: There are as many dimensions as there are variables.
cues.zh: 變數數量就是維度數。

cues.en: So in a dataset with four variables the sample space is for them.
cues.zh: 四個變數的資料集，樣本空間就是四維。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and see an example.
cues.zh: 看例子。

cues.en: Here we have some data plotted along to features X and Y and we went ahead and put a regression line
cues.zh: 這裡資料按 X、Y 兩個特徵繪製，放了最佳

cues.en: of best fit what we can do now is add an orthogonal line which is just at a right angle to that first line.
cues.zh: 迴歸線。可以再加一條與第一條成直角的正交線。

cues.en: And now we can begin to understand the components of our data set.
cues.zh: 開始理解資料的成分。

cues.en: Components are linear transformation that chooses a variable system for the data set such that the greatest
cues.zh: 成分是線性轉換，替資料選一套變數系統，讓最大

cues.en: variance of the data set comes to lie on the first axes and then likewise the second greatest variance on the second axes and so on.
cues.zh: 變異落在第一軸，第二大變異在第二軸，依此類推。

cues.en: And this process allows us to reduce the number of variables used in an analysis and if we look back at our figure we can see that that first principle line explains the 70 percent of the variation and
cues.zh: 能減少分析所需變數。回看圖，第一條主線解釋 70% 的變異，

cues.en: then the line orthogonal to that explains 28 percent of the variation.
cues.zh: 正交線解釋 28%。

cues.en: And right now we have 2 percent of the variation remaining unexplained.
cues.zh: 剩 2% 尚未解釋。

cues.en: And note that the components are uncorrelated.
cues.zh: 注意成分不相關，

cues.en: Since in the sample space they are orthogonal to each other.
cues.zh: 因為在樣本空間中彼此正交，

cues.en: Or at direkte right angles and we can continue this analysis into higher dimensions.
cues.zh: 成直角。也能延伸到更高維。

cues.en: Here we now have three components.
cues.zh: 現在三個成分。

cues.en: Component 1 that principal component explaining most of the variance and then component 2 and component 3 and a higher that mention.
cues.zh: 第一主成分解釋最多變異，再第二、第三成分，更高維，

cues.en: As we go into the z axes if we use this technique on a dataset with a large number of variables we can actually compress the amount of explained variation to just a few components.
cues.zh: 進入 Z 軸。對很多變數的資料用這技術，能把解釋變異濃縮到少數成分。

cues.en: However the most challenging part of PCa is interpreting the components for a work with Python or going
cues.zh: 但 PCA 最難是解讀成分。Python 實作，

cues.en: to do is walk through an example of how to perform PC-DOS sikat learn and will review this sort of theory as we go along.
cues.zh: 會展示 scikit-learn 做 PCA，沿途複習理論。

cues.en: So don't worry if you were 100 percent on the theory right now we're going to review it as we go through the process of performing PCa with Python.
cues.zh: 所以現在沒完全懂也不用擔心，做 Python PCA 時會複習。

cues.en: What we're also want to do is usually standardize our data by some sort of scale.
cues.zh: 通常也想先用某種尺度標準化資料。

cues.en: We're going to cover how to do that as well in the next lecture.
cues.zh: 下一堂會涵蓋。

cues.en: Since this algorithm is usually used for analysis of data and not a fully the playable model there won't be a portfolio project for this topic.
cues.zh: 演算法通常用於資料分析，不是完整可部署模型，所以沒有作品集專案。

cues.en: OK thanks everyone and I'll see you at the next lecture.
cues.zh: 好，謝謝大家，下一堂見。
